atlas.name: Destrieux atlas (Destrieux et al. 2010)
atlas.description: Anatomical parcellation of each hemisphere into 74 regions that separate gyri (G_) from sulci (S_). This is FreeSurfer's 'aparc.a2009s' atlas.

reference.text: Destrieux C, Fischl B, Dale A, Halgren E (2010). Automatic parcellation of human cortical gyri and sulci using standard anatomical nomenclature. NeuroImage 53, 1-15.

atlas.data_source: Vertex labels on fsLR 32k (conte69) from micapipe (MICA-MNI).
atlas.note: Region names are FreeSurfer abbreviations: G = gyrus, S = sulcus, G_and_S = gyrus and sulcus. Full names are listed in Table 1 of the reference.
